_about: Special dates. In the 7 days before each event, make 1 or 2 themed reels (never more), the last one published no later than 14:00 Madrid on the event day. A themed reel replaces the regular one that day; the category rotation resumes afterwards. Topic: a real, verifiable curiosity tied to the event (science of, history of, body during...). Keep the brand rules; small themed touches only (props, colours in the drawing, not the background).
